column4: Organization addons expose provider and plan descriptions but no verified tenant authorization relationship.

Aggregated datapoint statistics require an API key but provide only pagination and result wrappers.
Contact organization_name is address-book metadata, not a verified tenant lookup for contact update.

Company profit-and-loss report requires authentication without a verified company authorization mapping.
Company integrity summaries have only a summaries wrapper and no tenant lookup fields.
Company marketing metrics include connection context but no verified caller access rule.
Account category lookup has company and connection IDs but inferred accountRef does not establish ownership or tenancy.
Advanced game box scores require API-key authentication without explicit unrestricted-access evidence.
Football team identifies sporting data rather than an authorization tenant, and API access policy is unspecified.
Player season statistics include team data but no explicit unrestricted access or caller membership requirement.

Setting creatorEmail is provenance, not evidence of creator-only mutation or an ownership lookup.

Form ownedBy is inferred with no specified caller relationship or verified lookup binding.
Linked user-profile retrieval has unknown security and no verified owner-only access evidence.
My-user import listing is explicitly self-scoped but has no object lookup fields; OAuth user scope is not an application role.
User adminFlags and role fields do not prove an administrator requirement or owner lookup for this update.
User two-factor request has unknown security and token-response fields without an ownership binding.
PropertyOwnership describes a registry-check result, not API caller authorization, and security is unspecified.
Screenshot comparison's public_url field does not make this Basic-authenticated comparison operation unrestricted.
Summary restricts conversations to a token bubble, but pagination-only ERD cannot map that access boundary to a supported lookup.
Same-bubble conversation access involves user_a and user_b without a single verified owner lookup or tenant mapping.
Published-article listing explicitly permits anonymous authentication with security=[]; user and organization fields are article attribution rather than an owner-only restriction.
Record creator and copyright describe collection metadata; API-key security does not establish unrestricted API access.
Admin user inspection suggests privilege but the object branch lacks a verified subject binding and explicit allowed caller roles.
Admin user silencing is privileged-looking but supplied text does not resolve the role-versus-object policy or lookup.
Category-topic listing has unknown security and can_create_topic is response data, not unrestricted-read evidence.
Container User denotes process configuration rather than API ownership, and caller authorization is unspecified.
Node Role is a node attribute rather than a required caller role; security is unknown.
API-license lookup returns customer metadata but no verified subject relationship or explicit required membership tier.
System-event listing requires OAuth, while user_id filtering does not establish owner-only access or an administrator role.
Group-member removal exposes groupRoles and createdBy but does not identify the caller's required role or ownership mapping.
Node-comment createdBy is flattened authorship data with no verified owner-only edit rule or lookup binding.
Amendment access is explicitly limited to the creating API application, but no application ownership column is supplied.
Billing-note created_by is inferred and billing OAuth scopes do not establish owner-only access.
Custom policy retrieval has seller-account OAuth permissions but no supplied account ownership binding.
Fulfillment policy marketplaceId denotes marketplace context rather than caller tenant identity.
Organization update uses OAuth but inferred id and contact fields do not verify tenant lookup semantics.
Deployment createdBy and userEmail are provenance hints without a verified caller-owner relationship.
Changing order shipping details has unknown security and only address fields, not an order ownership lookup.
